name: ToxTeller
selection: Fitted LR, RF, SVM, and XGBoost classifiers
dependencies: scikit-learn, XGBoost, NumPy, pandas; a fitted scaler is required for inference
scope: Source release containing training/prediction code, original data, and static input definitions. Model weights, caches, and historical outputs are excluded.
notes: Historical scripts filtered peptide lengths to 10–50 amino acids, yielding test-set sizes of 1334 and 1676. Interpret historical training sample coverage using the corresponding run summaries.
